oracle_provenance.method: one freely-propagating adiabatic premixed flame solved twice at the same operating point -- mixture-averaged and unity-Lewis-number transport -- with the inlet velocity of each taken as its unstretched laminar flame speed and the reference value being the ratio of the second to the first
oracle_provenance.pass_tol_basis: flat 5% of the reference value. The band exists to catch a wrong configuration, not to grade numerical precision; the nearest wrong configuration for this track lands ~68% away, and the structural failures are caught by the gates.
oracle_provenance.gross_error_tol_basis: 20% of the reference value; diagnostic only, not part of the score
oracle_provenance.gt_type_note: Mechanism-specific solver reference, not an experimental measurement: the task asks for what this mechanism predicts.

unity_lewis_speed_ratio.description: Ratio of the unstretched laminar flame speed of ethane/air at phi=1.09, 316 K unburned, 1.3 atm under unity-Lewis-number transport to the same flame under mixture-averaged transport.
